preserved: All 30 query texts and their order; old keyed arms and plan-row gate superseded by ruling12.
batch_rule: Three native promptfoo batches of ten queries per repeat round; every query still receives three calls per arm. Preserve query order and alternate provider order per round. Start a batch only with at least 22 minutes before the paper window; native per-provider timeout is 60 seconds. No added retries. Failed or aborted batches cannot support adoption.
container_rule: Temporary upstream rootless container, loopback, isolated config/data, default engines, JSON enabled; remove afterward. No shared install.sh or plan row.

statistics.unit: 30 paired query means over three repeats; every error and timeout remains zero-credit in denominator
statistics.p95_method: nearest rank ceil(0.95*n), includes failures with native latency; missing latency prevents pass
statistics.secondary: MRR and duplicate fraction cannot override primary gates

limitations: Software/foundation documentation corpus; source-family discovery, not answer correctness or full research quality.
q27 preserves an ambiguous cache-mode phrase: its broad official workflow reference target cannot establish that capability.
Release queries require exact tag URL; source-topic queries allow official current branch aliases, and do not prove retrieved version matches.
No candidate win does not establish equivalence; owner changes/host installation stay separate.
DDGS auto may internally use keyless engines including Brave; no separate keyed provider arm is called.
primary_target_verification: Independent read-only review of official pinned docs and exact release API endpoints; root rechecks frozen patterns before execution.
